name: Pan-Seared Parmesan-Crusted Chicken Breast with Fettuccine (Captain's Gala Night 2)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Treasure · 1923 / Disney Wonder & Magic · Captain's Gala Menu
whyItWorks: Lean chicken breast coated in aged Parmesan breadcrumbs over soft white fettuccine ribbons is a hearty, low-fiber classic.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ask for light cream/butter on the fettuccine, hold any pancetta or mushroom garnish, and take a Lactaid.
